description: Administrators in post-secondary education and vocational training include faculty administrators and registrars of colleges or universities and administrators of vocational training schools. Faculty administrators manage the academic and related activities of faculties of colleges or universities. Registrars manage registration activities and academic records systems of colleges or universities. Administrators of vocational training schools manage the operations of vocational schools specializing in trades, technology, business or other vocational subjects.
duties: This group performs some or all of the following duties:
Plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate academic and related activities of a college or university faculty
Recommend curriculum revisions and additions and approve scheduling of courses
Direct, through subordinate staff, activities such as research and curriculum development
Plan, administer and control budgets for projects, programs, support services and equipment
Advise president or rector of university or college
Participate in activities of various faculty and college committees.
Plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate the registration activities and academic records system of a college or university
Review registration statistics and consult with faculty officials to develop registration policies
Direct activities of staff and others engaged in compiling information on courses, schedules and requirements for admission and graduation.
Plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate the activities of a private college or institute specializing in trades, technology or business
Consult with government regulatory and licensing agencies to ensure conformance to provincial standards
May recruit and hire teachers and other staff
requirements: Faculty administrators require a graduate degree in a field related to the academic faculty  and Several years of experience as a university professor or college teacher.
Registrars require an undergraduate degree in business administration or a related field  and Several years of experience in registration administration.
Administrators of vocational training schools usually require an undergraduate degree in business administration  or Expertise and certification in a subject of instruction.

activities.name: Estimating Quantifiable Characteristics

activities.name: Getting Information
activities.reason: Search, retrieval and summarization can assist gathering digital information; access and verification remain constraints.

activities.name: Identifying Objects, Actions and Events
activities.reason: Models can help classify supplied information or images, but direct observation and context are often needed.

activities.name: Inspecting Equipment, Structures or Material

activities.name: Monitoring Processes, Materials or Systems
activities.reason: Software can summarize readings and flag anomalies; monitoring physical processes requires sensors and intervention.

activities.name: Controlling Machines and Processes
activities.reason: Generating instructions does not itself control or safely operate physical equipment. Robotics is outside this index.

activities.name: Developing Technical Instructions

activities.name: Documenting and Recording Information
activities.reason: Transcription, structured extraction and document drafting are directly addressable by generative software.

activities.name: Electronic Maintenance
activities.reason: Diagnostic advice can assist, while handling, repairing and testing equipment remain physical activities.

activities.name: Handling and Manipulating Objects
activities.reason: Software alone cannot handle physical objects. This index excludes robotics.

activities.name: Managing Resources
activities.reason: Planning and analysis can be assisted; allocating resources and accepting responsibility require organizational authority.

activities.name: Mechanical Maintenance
activities.reason: Instructions can assist troubleshooting, but software does not perform hands-on mechanical repairs.

activities.name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices or Equipment
activities.reason: Vehicle and equipment operation are outside this software-only generative AI scope.

activities.name: Performing Physical Activities
activities.reason: Bodily effort and movement cannot be performed by software alone.
